records.summary: Harvest V2 is a broad REST API available to all accounts, including Free and trial accounts. Current auth is a user-tied PAT or OAuth 2.0; V1 Basic auth is legacy. Harvest also operates a remote MCP server at https://api.harvestapp.com/mcp.

records.next_action: Create a PAT in Harvest ID Developers for a personal prototype or register an OAuth 2.0 application for multi-user integrations.
